workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
the verso running head writes the book title literally (BOOK_TITLE): {title} is blank in every document without its own frontmatter
config.locale does not localise Figure: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand
Rozha One ships one face: the kit provider snaps the bold and italic renderToPdf asks for
the contents heading style restates breakBefore: { enabled: false }, or it inherits the H1's parity 'odd' and lands behind a blank page 2
contents numbers are painted centred on the line, ~0.7 mm above the title's baseline; no toc option moves them in 1.4.1
the colophon sets one statement per paragraph: a no-break space would not keep "CC BY 4.0" on one line
later chapters refer back to the October frame in words ('The same frame in January…'), never with :ref{id="autumn-frame"}, which would place Figure 1.1 again in their own document

the H1 level sets span: 'page' in this single-column book only so that the opener paints unclipped: a heading design kept in the column is clipped at the column's top edge, which would cut the comb that reaches the top of the page
every design text's lineHeight is a multiple of its size, never pt(): a Dimension would silently drop the opener's reservation (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
hyphenation matches exact codes only, so the config sets locale: t({ en: 'en-us', es: 'es' }) (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
